items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I could do Lena Horne and Ella... I can do Nellie Lutcher, Rose Murphy and a lot of them; Billie Holiday, especially.

ctx.x: That long tradition of vaudeville performance and entertainers, even going into Armstrong and Dizzy Gillespie, the clowning…tell me about those performance aspects with some of the vocal impersonations, could you tell me about that?
I could do Lena Horne and Ella, not Etta Jones, I keep calling her James sometimes. I can do Nellie Lutcher, Rose Murphy and a lot of them; Billie Holiday, especially.
I assumed the audience really loved that.
